hook.name: SudoCatHook
hook.description: Single-pool hook for a native ETH / SudoCat token pair. Applies a 2% LP fee via dynamic fee override and takes a 3% routing fee per swap: ETH buy-side fees fund holder rewards claimable from the hook; token sell-side fees are permanently burned. Six immutable fee-exempt addresses can bypass all fees by providing EIP-712 signed hookData.
